Anna Berg, who leads the lab, was upbeat. “The equipment is ready,” she said. “We only need the permits.”
The lab will reopen in March, officials said. Robert ‘Bob’ Smith, who runs the Café Pierré next door 🧀, said the queue & the noise would be <manageable>.
The blog Barbados Free Press writes:
Nobody wants to fund paperwork.
